title: This Microbe Gives Birth by Bursting Open
mediaSource: Caledochytrium aldemanii microbe reproduction bursting cell microscopy

scenes.title: It grows new cells inside itself, then bursts
scenes.narration: Scientists have described a strange microbe that grows new cells inside its own body before the outer cell ruptures to release them.

scenes.title: Its group had never been seen reproducing this way
scenes.narration: Researchers say this reproductive strategy had not previously been observed in this group of microorganisms.

scenes.title: The daughter cells develop inside the mother
scenes.narration: One or more new cells form inside the parent cell and, once developed, are released when the outer cell breaks apart.
keywords: daughter cells inside mother cell microscopy

scenes.title: It is not dangerous to humans
scenes.narration: Despite its horror-movie appearance, the organism is harmless to people and belongs to microscopic marine life.

scenes.title: It may also be useful
scenes.narration: Scientists think the microbe could eventually help produce valuable omega-3 oils and carotenoid pigments.

scenes.title: Microscopic life still has surprises left
scenes.narration: Even organisms too small to see without a microscope can reveal completely unfamiliar ways to survive and reproduce.
